items.root_cause: Two defects meet. (a) The verdict input fingerprint (lib/chain-verdict-lib.ps1 Get-ChainVerdictInputHashes) hashes RAW BYTES of JSON inputs whose line endings git owns (eol=lf) while the chain's PS 5.1 writers leave them CRLF, so any git operation that round-trips a dirty input (stash, checkout, autostash rebase) moves the fingerprint with no content change, and the chain withholds a board guards did pass. (b) A scheduled session (grocery-alert-triage STEP 0.5, 09:45) writes the production checkout on a clock that assumes the chain has finished; on 09-27 it had not. INFERENCE CAVEAT, stated loudly: the 09-27 verdict's per-path 'inputs' map was overwritten by 09-28's verdict at 08:21:11, so WHICH input moved is inferred, not read: the autostash pull is the only recorded writer in the window (71 s before the re-read), product-urls.json is the one tracked input the chain leaves dirty and CRLF, and the three ignored inputs (comparison, name-drift, recipe-board) are never touched by a stash. The same verdict-mismatch withhold also happened on 2026-09-20 (capture-run-daily-2026-09-20.log:140), cause not reconstructed.

surface_fix.what: none needed: 09-27's withheld board was superseded by 09-28's chain and 3451de927 (09:27 today) shipped the 09-28 board by hand

root_fix.what: the verdict fingerprint measures CONTENT, not line endings, and a STALE-INPUTS withhold names the paths that moved and pages as itself
root_fix.exact_change: 1) lib/chain-verdict-lib.ps1 Get-ChainVerdictInputHashes: hash the file's bytes with every 0x0D byte removed (all 7 inputs are JSON; a raw CR can only be inter-token whitespace, a CR inside a string must be escaped, so the parsed value cannot differ) and keep 'absent'/'unreadable' as they are. Write-ChainVerdict records inputs_hash_basis = 'json-cr-stripped-v1'; Read-ChainVerdictStatus treats a verdict whose basis differs from the reader's as STALE-INPUTS (fail closed, as a verdict with no fingerprint is today). 2) Read-ChainVerdictStatus adds 'moved' = the paths whose recorded inputs[path] differs from the hash now (the verdict already stores the per-path map), and 'why' names them. 3) grocery/capture-run.ps1 line ~1470: when $verdict.status is STALE-INPUTS, book lane 'verdict-stale' (not 'guards-blocked'), print the moved paths, and page once as 'Daily chain withheld its board: <paths> changed after guards ran - <date>' via Set-FailedLanePaged so the watchdog's RUN RECORD fold names the real cause; BLOCKED keeps 'guards-blocked'. 4) register the new alert type in grocery/alert-registry.json (audit-alert-registry refuses an unregistered call site). Do NOT add a verdict archive: the moved-path line in the run log is the attribution this item lacked.

items.root_cause: lib/chain-code-currency.ps1 Get-TcArtifactProducers derives the producer set in a way that is wrong in BOTH directions: its roots are only lines that name the artifact AND write on the same line, which for costed.json, board.json and price-history.json are self-test sandbox writes while the real builders (cost-recipes.ps1, build-deals-page.ps1) write through a path variable and are missed; and its closure follows every .ps1/.js NAME in code, including names inside string literals, fixtures and doc text, so 116 to 183 of 650 scripts count as producers of each served file. The real builders were only reached by accident through that promiscuous walk, and any mid-run landing of nearly any grocery or lib script pages 'stale artifact'. Occurrences since the check shipped 2026-09-23: 1 page (today), 0 real.

surface_fix.what: none: the two named artifacts were not built by changed code, and the next run rebuilds everything anyway

root_fix.what: derive producers from the scripts that actually WRITE the artifact (including through a path variable) and walk only INVOCATION edges
root_fix.exact_change: 1) Roots: keep today's same-line write rule AND add a dataflow root: a line '$<var> = ...<artifact leaf>...' in a script where some other non-comment line has a write verb ($script:CccWriteVerb) and references $<var> (whole-word). 2) Edges: follow a named .ps1/.js only when the line naming it also carries an invocation token: leading dot-source '. ', call operator '&', '-File', 'node', 'Invoke-Native'/'Invoke-NativeScript', 'Start-Process', 'powershell', 'RunPS'. Keep the comment stripping and the $script:CccHubNames orchestrator rule (count ALL names on the hub test, as today). 3) ops/chain-manifest.json exclude_globs: add 'grocery/test-auditors/*.ps1' (the prototype shows units-01..05 as board.json/feed/price-history roots through fixture writes). 4) Header: update the SCOPE OF A CLEAN ANSWER line: still unsound for a path assembled across functions or parameters (cost-recipes -OutFile) and a script named through a computed string; say so. Prototype measured over 650 scripts at 812fad5b3 (scratchpad ccc-inv2.ps1, roots rule 1 + edges rule 2, before rule 3): smp-feed 116 -> 19 (export-feed, feed-everyday-ps, live-price-fill.js kept: the founding cec9779a3 case still fires), board.json 137 -> 82 (build-deals-page now IN, and 12 real writers added such as set-board-cell, assemble-board-brands, add-recipe-board-rows), costed.json 137 -> 36 (cost-recipes now IN as a root), recipes-db.json 135 -> 45 (sync-recipesdb-cost/-buy/-grams/-macros roots), price-history.json 183 -> 43 (build-deals-page, update-history, purge-bad-lows). flag-verify-lib and audit-flag-verification leave all five. Rule 2 alone is NOT enough: measured edges-only, costed.json drops to 33 and LOSES cost-recipes.ps1, because its roots are all fixtures.
